results.title: Two friends, uneven order, 10% tip
results.summary:
Added Asha and Ben to the bill.
Added Pizza priced at 600 and shared it between Asha and Ben after unchecking Asha before adding the item.
Added Soda priced at 100 and assigned it only to Ben.
Set the tip to 10%.
The final totals were Asha owes 330.00, Ben owes 440.00, and the bill total is 770.00.
